capabilities: play ambience music across the vault
assign audio tracks to individual files through metadata
stream audio from YouTube and SoundCloud URLs
play local audio files stored in the vault
disambiguation: Despite the .md-style name, it is not a Markdown or note tool; it plays audio ambience in the vault.
extras: The README mixes plugin documentation with instructions for using the repository as a code template; detailed usage documentation is deferred to a separate wiki that is still listed as unfinished in the roadmap.
motivation: The author observed that users of all kinds (zettelkasten, engineering docs, DND campaigns, world building) want to attach music to projects or files reflecting atmosphere or mood, and built the plugin to solve that.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach musical accompaniment to a vault or to individual notes to set an atmosphere or working mood.

relations.evidence: support of local (from vault) and URLs (Youtube, Soundcloud) versions of audio
support of local (from vault) and URLs (Youtube, Soundcloud) versions of audio

summary: Ambience player that plays music in the vault and assigns audio tracks to individual files via metadata, using local audio files or YouTube/SoundCloud URLs.
